title: Missing image alternative
rationale: Images and image controls need alternatives that convey their purpose.
remediation: Describe the image’s purpose in its current context.
Use an empty alt for purely decorative images and a functional label for image buttons.

title: Review empty image alternative
rationale: An empty alternative is appropriate for decoration. A human must confirm the image has no instructional or functional purpose.
remediation: Check whether the image carries information available nowhere else.
Keep alt empty for decoration or supply equivalent text for informative imagery.

title: Unnamed form control
rationale: Screen reader users need the control name to enter the correct information.
remediation: Add a visible label and associate it with the control’s unique ID.
Retain instructions separately through aria-describedby where needed.

title: Skipped heading level
rationale: Heading rank should reflect section nesting and relationships.
remediation: Review the document outline and restore the appropriate parent heading.
Choose heading levels by structure and use CSS for visual sizing.

title: Missing primary heading
rationale: A descriptive primary heading helps users identify the page. Its absence requires structural review.
remediation: Add a visible heading that names the page’s main purpose.
Check that subordinate headings describe their sections.

title: Missing document language
rationale: The document language allows assistive technology to choose suitable pronunciation.
remediation: Set the primary BCP 47 language on the root html element.
Mark substantial passages in another language with their own lang attribute.

title: Unnamed link or button
rationale: Interactive elements need an accessible name that communicates their action or destination.
remediation: Add descriptive visible text where possible.
Provide an accessible name for icon-only controls.

title: Missing main landmark
rationale: A main landmark supports navigation to primary content. Other bypass mechanisms also exist.
remediation: Wrap primary content in a main element.
Provide a keyboard-accessible skip link pointing to that region.

title: Zoom restricted by viewport
rationale: People with low vision may need to enlarge text to 200%.
remediation: Remove viewport directives that disable zoom or cap it below two times.
Test enlarged text and responsive reflow without loss of content.

title: Missing frame title
rationale: A specific frame title describes the purpose of embedded content. Review other accessible naming where applicable.
remediation: Add a concise title describing the embedded content.
Evaluate the embedded experience independently.

title: Table needs header review
rationale: Data tables need programmatic headers so people can identify each cell’s context.
remediation: Use th with scope for simple row and column headers.
Use CSS for page layout and review complex table associations manually.

title: Low inline text contrast
rationale: Normal text requires a 4.5:1 ratio. Qualifying large text requires 3:1.
remediation: Choose foreground and background colors that meet the appropriate ratio.
Verify computed colors and states in a browser, including hover and focus.

title: Keyboard operation
rationale: Every applicable interaction must work through a keyboard interface.
remediation: Operate menus and forms with Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space and applicable arrow keys.
Use native controls or implement the expected keyboard behavior for custom widgets.

title: Visible keyboard focus
rationale: Keyboard users need a visible indicator of which control has focus.
remediation: Keep or replace the browser’s focus outline.
Check the indicator against surrounding colors and in high contrast modes.

title: Clear form errors
rationale: Input errors need text that identifies the affected field and explains the problem.
remediation: Describe the specific error next to the field.
Associate the message with the control and move focus to a summary where useful.
example: Enter a valid email address.

title: Announced status updates
rationale: Assistive technology should be able to present status messages without moving focus.
remediation: Keep a live status region in the DOM before its text changes.
Announce relevant progress or completion without interrupting the user.

title: Responsive reflow
rationale: At the equivalent of 320 CSS pixels, most content should avoid scrolling in two dimensions.
remediation: Test at a narrow viewport and at high zoom.
Allow content to wrap and keep complex two-dimensional regions independently scrollable.

title: Prerecorded captions
rationale: Prerecorded synchronized media generally needs captions for meaningful speech and sound.
remediation: Publish synchronized captions and review names and speaker changes.
Include meaningful sounds when needed to understand the content.
